---
title: "Popularity of the Name Isabella Over Time"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Read the SSA baby names dataset
baby_names <- read_csv("ssa-baby-names.csv")

# Filter for the name Isabella and sum counts per year
isabella <- baby_names |>
  filter(name == "Isabella", sex == "F")
```

The chart below shows the number of female babies named **Isabella** in the United States each year from 1880 to 2025, using data from the Social Security Administration.

```{r}
ggplot(isabella, aes(x = year, y = count)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Babies Named Isabella in the U.S. (1880–2025)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Babies",
    caption = "Source: Social Security Administration"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
